'''Melen Toobo''' was the head of the [[Coruscant Wildlife Management Department]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He had the department carry out a secret project on [[Coruscani ogre]]s, to try and turn them into [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] laborers.
